remarks: Welcome to this exceptional single-story residence nestled in the highly sought-after Village Homes community of Westlake Village. Offering approximately 2,143 square feet of beautifully appointed living space, this inviting three-bedroom, two-bath home features a dedicated office and an effortless indoor-outdoor flow designed for both comfortable everyday living and sophisticated entertaining. The thoughtfully designed floor plan is complemented by an abundance of natural light and serene views of the surrounding mountains and lush greenbelts. The private backyard is truly an entertainer’s retreat, featuring a sparkling pool and plenty of space to lounge, dine, and gather with family
